input.comment: [Playbook] We have narrowed our indemnity to the Content and Properties we supply and our breach of applicable Law, deleting the open-ended catch-all for our acts or omissions and any breach of warranty, and removed the knowledge qualifier from Kubient's indemnity for Creative served through the Auction Platform so that third-party IP and content claims sit with the party controlling the demand source. Our position is that the customer-side indemnity stays narrow while the vendor indemnity covers IP infringement without a knowledge cut-back.
input.summary: Narrow Customer indemnity to Content/Properties and breach of Law; remove knowledge qualifier from Kubient's Creative indemnity.
